title: Haan ye mere bete hai
body:
Sher hue do waarde lashkar
maqtal mein barpa tha mehshar
fakhr se apne sar ko uthakar
kehti thi abbas ki khwahar
<<MINI>>
haan ye mere bete hai..(4)
ek hai mohammad aur dusra hai aun
haan ye mere bete hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Naam hai inke aun o mohammad
haider ke akkas hai ye
mulk e wafa ke dono makee'n hai
dono hi abbas hai ye
fatima zehra ke hai nawase
mamu par jaa'n dete hai
<<MINI>>
haan ye mere bete hai..(2)
ek hai mohammad aur dusra hai aun
haan ye mere bete hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Maine inhe takeed ye ki thi
darya par mat jaana tum
maqtal mein pyaase hi rehna
sabr e ali dikhlana tum
waqt e wigha ye bint e asad ki
god ke paale lagte hai
<<MINI>>
haan ye mere bete hai..(2)
ek hai mohammad aur dusra hai aun
haan ye mere bete hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Aun mohammad se kehta tha
bhai bhool na jaana tum
hum hai ali akbar ka sadqa
amma ka nazrana tum
shukre khuda amma ke sajde
fakhr se kehte rehte hai
<<MINI>>
haan ye mere bete hai..(2)
ek hai mohammad aur dusra hai aun
haan ye mere bete hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ghar jaana hai khoo'n mein nahake
pohche jab khaimo mein laashe
khushk zabaa ko dekhke amma
kehde hai shehzade pyaase
hukm e madar maanne wale
marke zinda rehte hai
<<MINI>>
haan ye mere bete hai..(2)
ek hai mohammad aur dusra hai aun
haan ye mere bete hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Aun o mohammad ki ye hasrat
puri hui zindaan mein jaakar
jab waqt e azaadi aaya
nauk e sina se utre jab sar
boli zainab peet ke sar ko
lawaris jo dikhte hai
<<MINI>>
haan ye mere bete hai..(2)
ek hai mohammad aur dusra hai aun
haan ye mere bete hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aun o mohammad jaise bete
kaash khuda rehan o raza de
fakhr se sar uncha ho maa ka
baap kare sajde pe sajde
rooh e abu talib ye pukare
haider jinko rote hai
<<MINI>>

ek hai mohammad aur dusra hai aun
